notes: v0.6.14: add modem73 to BUILD.md recipe and IMAGE-PACKAGES.md. modem73 is installed via `pipx install modem73` (PyPI) with a `sudo ln -sf /home/pi/.local/bin/modem73 /usr/bin/modem73` symlink because the launcher scripts reference `/usr/bin/modem73` directly. The launcher already wires the Modem73 Config TUI row to `start_modem73_tui.sh` (lxterminal + modem73) and the headless loopback path to `start_modem73_loopback.sh` (modem73 --headless --config). The recipe was missing the install step; both BUILD.md Step 3 and IMAGE-PACKAGES.md (new "Pipx venvs" section) now document it. Discovered during the clean-image-build prep: an operator reviewing BUILD.md flagged that modem73 was unwired even though the launcher uses it. Caught before the clean build ran — saved an "almost built an image without modem73" outcome.
